newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Injury toll rises to 94 in Austrian rail crash.
newsitem.headline: Injury toll rises to 94 in Austrian rail crash.

text.p: Over 90 people were injured, many of them children, when two trains collided in the region of Arbing in Upper Austria, state television reported on Wednesday.
The Red Cross said as many as 94 people were hurt in Tuesday's crash, 30 seriously. Many of the casualties were children returning from school outings.
Some of the injured were flown to hospital by helicopter, the television said.
The accident happened when one of the train drivers failed to heed a stop signal when leaving Arbing railway station, it added.
